title: Mike Macdonald: Not sure when Sam Darnold will be back, but I'm optimistic

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald: Not sure when Sam Darnold will be back, but I'm optimistic
sources.description: The Seahawks ruled quarterback Sam Darnold out for Week 2 a couple of days ago, but his health was still a topic for head coach Mike Macdonald during Friday's press conference.
